assumptions.statement: The Carrenza environment already supports serving HTTP requests on port 80, establishing a baseline for feature parity.
assumptions.quote: This functionality exists in the Carrenza environment and we aim to replicate this feature to maintain feature parity.

assumptions.statement: The Bouncer servers are capable of handling HTTP traffic on port 80 directly, rather than requiring the load balancer to redirect to HTTPS.
assumptions.quote: Add a second listener to the load balancer so that HTTP request on port 80 can be served by the Bouncer servers.

warnings: dropped ungrounded assumption: 'The existing infrastructure uses Terraform for managing the load balancer configuration, allowing for declarative changes to listeners.' (quote: 'the terraform plan was changed so that the input to the `aws/lb` terraform module specifies a second listener')
